text:
Welcome to the Presidential Palace Historical Site and Ho Chi Minh Stilt House! This location is steeped in history and is closely associated with the daily life and work of President Ho Chi Minh. As you explore the grounds, you will find the charming stilt house, a serene fish pond, and lovely paths that offer insights into the great leader’s life.

Please note that visiting the Presidential Palace interior is not included in this tour. The grounds have their own specific schedule, so make sure to check the opening hours. For your convenience, the site is open from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM, and again from 1:30 PM to 4:00 PM. However, it is closed on Monday and Friday afternoons.

Admission is free for Vietnamese citizens and is 40,000 VND for international visitors. I highly recommend that you take advantage of the morning session, as it tends to be less crowded, allowing you to fully enjoy this historic site. 

Feel free to ask if you have any questions, and enjoy your visit!
